format: Contract manifest; executable validators are frozen by source hash, not an external JSON Schema validator

decomposition.span_convention: Code derives zero-based exclusive offsets from unique exact quotes; absent/ambiguous/out-of-order/overlapping quotes are rejected
decomposition.coverage: All content words, quantities, units and conditions; no split token or unseparated AND
decomposition.repair: At most 2 attempts; validation-specific feedback and previous output (at most 6000 characters), original claim unchanged
decomposition.semantic_gate: 18 unique development claims; all structural checks AND human predicate/coverage/quantifier/entity-metric/time-condition review before full 39-case inference

assessment.truth_semantics: Positive predicate before applying the quantifier
assessment.complete_coverage: Quoted nonempty population with unique members and one observation per declared member

numeric.arithmetic: Source-grounded Decimal; value comparison or ordered before/after change
numeric.unknown_policy: No implicit unit conversion, unsupported comparisons or ambiguous association

result.aggregation: Per-quantifier part decisions, then AND across parts
